section_summary: This section records the movements, destinations, cargoes and health clearances of Japanese merchant vessels from late March through April 4, 1941. Most reports are followed by State Department paraphrases prepared for the Navy. A Navy letter requests continued reports on Japanese ships carrying iron ore from Malaya.

people.name: Lawton
people.role: Sender of Ciudad Trujillo vessel report

people.name: Foster
people.role: Sender of São Paulo vessel reports

people.name: R. E. Schuirmann
people.role: Captain, U.S. Navy; signer of information request

subfiles.title: Rakuyo Maru arrival, cargo and departure at Manzanillo
subfiles.about: Reports Rakuyo Maru’s passage through Manzanillo and its cargo and passengers.
subfiles.summary: The ship sailed toward Japan via Los Angeles after loading mercury, molybdenum and turpentine.

subfiles.title: Rakuyo Maru report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays Hoyt’s Manzanillo report to naval operations.
subfiles.summary: Gives the vessel’s route, passenger changes and cargo.

subfiles.title: Kurama Maru departure from Yokohama
subfiles.about: Reports Kurama Maru’s March 26 departure for Los Angeles.
subfiles.summary: Lists its route through South African and South American ports and the Panama Canal.

subfiles.title: Kurama Maru report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays the Kurama Maru sailing report.
subfiles.summary: Repeats its Los Angeles destination and intermediate ports.

subfiles.title: Yamabiko Maru at Montevideo
subfiles.about: Reports Yamabiko Maru’s arrival and planned voyage to Buenos Aires.
subfiles.summary: It is expected back in Montevideo April 8 or 9.

subfiles.title: Yamabiko Maru report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays Yamabiko Maru’s Montevideo and Buenos Aires movements.
subfiles.summary: Notes its arrival, departure that night and expected return.

subfiles.title: Kamogawa Maru health clearance at Barahona
subfiles.about: Reports a bill of health for Kamogawa Maru’s departure from Barahona.
subfiles.summary: The vessel cleared for Cristóbal, with return bunkering at San Pedro reported.

subfiles.title: Taketoyo Maru cargo and expected departure
subfiles.about: Reports Taketoyo Maru’s lead and antimony cargo and intended departure.
subfiles.summary: Its 5,100 tons are reportedly destined for Japan via the Panama Canal and Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Taketoyo Maru report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays Taketoyo Maru’s expected departure and route.
subfiles.summary: It was expected to leave Tampico for Los Angeles, reportedly continuing to Japan.

subfiles.title: Bills of health for four Japanese vessels
subfiles.about: Lists health clearances granted since March 22.
subfiles.summary: Names Kamakura Maru, Yamazuki Maru, Awazisan Maru and Terukawa Maru with their destinations.

subfiles.title: Yokohama sailing reports
subfiles.about: Reports sailings of Arabia Maru, Hakone and Bangkok Maru.
subfiles.summary: Arabia Maru headed for eastern South America via Los Angeles and Panama.

subfiles.title: Yokohama sailing reports for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays reported March 27 sailings from Yokohama.
subfiles.summary: Lists Arabia Maru, Kamakura, Bangkok Maru and Hakone and their routes.

subfiles.title: Osaka bills of health
subfiles.about: Reports health clearances for Mansei Maru and Omurosan Maru.
subfiles.summary: Their destinations were the Philippines and San Francisco, respectively.

subfiles.title: Osaka health clearances for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays the Osaka clearances for Mansei Maru and Omurosan Maru.
subfiles.summary: States each vessel’s destination.

subfiles.title: Yodogawa departure
subfiles.about: Reports Yodogawa’s March 28 departure.
subfiles.summary: Its reported route was to Madras, Bombay and Iran.

subfiles.title: Yodogawa report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays Yodogawa’s reported departure.
subfiles.summary: Repeats its destinations of Madras, Bombay and Iran.

subfiles.title: Atlas Maru departure from Bombay
subfiles.about: Reports Atlas Maru’s March 30 sailing for Japan.
subfiles.summary: The route was via Colombo and Singapore; Donovan asks that the Navy be informed.

subfiles.title: Atlas Maru report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays Atlas Maru’s departure from Bombay.
subfiles.summary: Notes its route to Japan through Colombo and Singapore.

subfiles.title: Hawaii Maru at Santos
subfiles.about: Reports Hawaii Maru’s arrival at and departure from Santos.
subfiles.summary: It came from Kobe and sailed for Yokohama via South Africa.

subfiles.title: Hawaii Maru report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays Hawaii Maru’s movements at Santos.
subfiles.summary: Gives its March 22 arrival and March 27 departure.

subfiles.title: Sanuki Maru at Buenaventura
subfiles.about: Reports Sanuki Maru’s March 31 call at Buenaventura.
subfiles.summary: It arrived from Balboa and departed for Callao and Valparaíso.

subfiles.title: Sanuki Maru report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays Sanuki Maru’s call at Buenaventura.
subfiles.summary: Repeats its arrival from Balboa and onward destinations.

subfiles.title: Lima Maru and Anyo Maru at Singapore
subfiles.about: Reports arrivals and onward sailings of Lima Maru and Anyo Maru.
subfiles.summary: Lima Maru came from Hong Kong; Anyo Maru came from Sumatra.

subfiles.title: Singapore vessel report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays the Singapore movements of Lima Maru and Anyo Maru.
subfiles.summary: Gives their origins, arrival dates and onward routes.

subfiles.title: Buenos Aires Maru at Santos
subfiles.about: Reports Buenos Aires Maru’s March 29 call at Santos.
subfiles.summary: It arrived from Rio Grande and sailed toward Los Angeles via Rio de Janeiro and Panama.

subfiles.title: Buenos Aires Maru report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays Buenos Aires Maru’s call at Santos.
subfiles.summary: Repeats its arrival point and Los Angeles route.

subfiles.title: Asama Maru, Ayama and Yamazuki departures
subfiles.about: Reports late-March departures of three vessels.
subfiles.summary: Asama Maru sailed for Manila, Ayama for Seattle and Yamazuki for eastern South America.

subfiles.title: Yokohama departures for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays the departures of Asama Maru, Ayama and Yamazuki.
subfiles.summary: Provides their dates, destinations and Yamazuki’s intermediate ports.

subfiles.title: Akagi Maru at Antofagasta
subfiles.about: Reports Akagi Maru’s arrival from Arica and departure for Coquimbo.
subfiles.summary: The vessel arrived April 1 and sailed April 2.

subfiles.title: Akagi Maru report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays Akagi Maru’s Antofagasta movements.
subfiles.summary: Repeats its arrival from Arica and departure for Coquimbo.

subfiles.title: Note on Commander Frothingham’s request
subfiles.about: Records Frothingham’s request to obtain information and disregard a March 31 memorandum.
subfiles.summary: Brief internal note recording the revised request.

subfiles.title: Navy request for Japanese iron-ore shipping reports
subfiles.about: Requests reports from Singapore on Japanese ships carrying iron ore from Malaya.
subfiles.summary: The Navy asks that incoming consular information be furnished to its Naval Intelligence Division.

subfiles.title: Nissyo Maru departure
subfiles.about: Reports Nissyo Maru’s March 31 sailing.
subfiles.summary: The tanker sailed for Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Nissyo Maru report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays the tanker Nissyo Maru’s departure.
subfiles.summary: States that it departed for Los Angeles on March 31.

subfiles.title: Lisbon Maru and Syunko Maru at Singapore
subfiles.about: Reports Singapore calls by Lisbon Maru and Syunko Maru.
subfiles.summary: Both arrived from Bombay and sailed for Japan, by different routes.

subfiles.title: Singapore vessel report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays Lisbon Maru’s and Syunko Maru’s Singapore calls.
subfiles.summary: Lists their arrival and departure dates and routes toward Japan.

subfiles.title: Anyo Maru departure from Bombay
subfiles.about: Reports Anyo Maru’s departure for Japan.
subfiles.summary: Donovan gives Singapore as an intermediate port and asks that the Navy be informed.

subfiles.title: Anyo Maru report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays Anyo Maru’s reported departure from Bombay.
subfiles.summary: States that it sailed for Japan via Singapore.
